title: "The Bond Films"

## James Bond Film Revenue

This page explores how revenue for James Bond films has changed over time.

```{python}
#| echo: true

# import libraries
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# load dataset
films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

# choose only James Bond films
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]

# sorting films by release year
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```

## Revenue Over Time

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide revenue of James Bond films over time."

# make line plot
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])

# add labels
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Film Revenue Over Time")

# display plot
plt.show()
```

## Release Years

The first James Bond film in this dataset was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].min())`, and the last was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.
